Mia wrote about the day in the diary. Mia bought a hat at the shop yesterday. Last Monday, Mia and Lily went to the coding club. The scientist shouted 'Eureka!' when the experiment finally worked.
Mia wants to be a doctor in the future. The weather was sunny that day. Lily is interested in singing. Our headteacher praised the class for winning the competition.

It takes twenty minutes to get to the coding club by bike. Mia and Lily had great fun there. There are always many people at the science museum.
